_readme: HAND-MAINTAINED by the deciding humans (never by the agent). One entry per dark switch, keyed by its register key (report_config key, 'frozen:<lot id>' or a nested arm such as 'sla_wan_config.notify.enabled'). Fill only what has been decided; leave a field out (or null) when it is not decided — node tools/agent/flag-register.js lists it in docs/ops/FLAG-DECISIONS-GAPS.md. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. 'owner' is a NAMED person (the profile already carries the deciding role). 'expiry' = the date the switch must be reviewed or deleted; node tools/agent/flag-register.js --stale reports passed expiries and decision deadlines, and entries whose switch no longer exists.

_fields.owner: named person who decides and answers for the switch
_fields.risk: low | medium | high + one line on what could go wrong
_fields.dependencies: other switches / data / people needed first
_fields.canary_site: site code where it is turned on first
_fields.rollback_trigger: the observable condition that makes the owner set it back to its default
_fields.success_metric: the value-scoreboard metric (or other measure) and the change expected
_fields.decision_deadline: YYYY-MM-DD — date the go / no-go is due
_fields.expiry: YYYY-MM-DD — date the switch is reviewed (kept, re-dated or deleted)
